rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Fate Keeps Reconnecting Us
card.instruction: Treat every coincidence, interruption, and repeated encounter as proof that this connection is meant to continue.

transfer.action: I pause beside {prop} because we've met again.
transfer.opening: We've met again. We're clearly meant to keep talking. {request}
transfer.response: Even a shared street can keep arranging another conversation. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then it put us within talking distance. Where are you going next?

originalTransfer.action: I add {prop} to my map of our accidental meetings.
originalTransfer.opening: Third time this week. The map's getting insistent. {request}
originalTransfer.response: Even the coat rack has arranged another meeting. {counter}
originalTransfer.closing: A remarkably persistent arrangement for two people avoiding a conversation.

card.title: Fate Keeps Reconnecting Us
card.instruction: Treat every coincidence, interruption, and repeated encounter as proof that this connection is meant to continue.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: Third time this week we've met outside the bakery. Fate's persistent.

originalDialogue.speaker: B
originalDialogue.text: We live on the same street.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: Then fate knows how to keep you available.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Third time this week outside the bakery. Fate clearly wants us to catch up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We live on the same street.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. It keeps putting us within talking distance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm moving tomorrow. This is my last loaf here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it caught us just in time. Give me your new address before it has to start again.

card.title: Fate Keeps Reconnecting Us
card.instruction: Treat every coincidence, interruption, and repeated encounter as proof that this connection is meant to continue.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: We both reached for this coat. The universe wants us talking.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: And somehow my hand found your conversation starter.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: Certainly. Let's see where the sleeves lead us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We both reached for this coat. First reunion in ten years, and the universe won't let us leave.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's mine. Yours is still on the rack.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it borrowed your coat to stop me missing you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here's yours. Come on, we can share the taxi queue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Coats, now taxis. It's arranging this in stages. Where are you headed?

bindings.scope: Fresh binding-only review of an explicit transfer-body amendment. Read the exact card, both original and accepted candidate single dialogues, and every original/proposed transfer field. Are the proposed fields faithful to the exact mechanism and their described source material? Identify real residual contradictions or unsupported details. Seed hashes still describe the historical originals; validated integration will bind the accepted dialogue only after your compatibility assessment. A compiled transfer is not an individually reviewed pair. Do not score single or pair dialogue; records must be empty. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
